Description: The measure to put in a visual together with the Scenario Comparison items. On its own it is Outturn (plan basis), the Actual of a comparison. The Scenario Comparison items act only on this measure and pass every other measure through unchanged.
Expression: [Outturn (plan basis)]

Description: Rank of the Spending Review group in context among the groups that have a value, by the year-to-date variance % (the Variance % item of Scenario Comparison under the YTD item of Time Intelligence, taken on Comparison Amount), the largest first (1 is the biggest overspend against plan); equal values share a rank and the next rank is skipped. BLANK where the group has no plan or no outturn on the plan's basis. The plan is published by group, not by current department, so the rank is over Spending Review groups. A year-to-date plan exists only at period 12 or for a whole year, so a month before the year end gives BLANK. Each group's value is worked out once, in ADDCOLUMNS, and RANKX ranks that column; it returns the same ranks as the plain form kept hidden as Department Group Rank (YTD Variance %) (naive). Use it with no Time Intelligence or Scenario Comparison item selected.
Expression:
VAR YtdVariancePercent =
    CALCULATE ( [Comparison Amount], 'Time Intelligence'[Time Calculation] = "YTD", 'Scenario Comparison'[Comparison] = "Variance %" )
VAR Groups =
    FILTER (
        ADDCOLUMNS (
            ALLSELECTED ( 'Spending Review Group' ),
            "@ytd", CALCULATE ( [Comparison Amount], 'Time Intelligence'[Time Calculation] = "YTD", 'Scenario Comparison'[Comparison] = "Variance %" )
        ),
        NOT ISBLANK ( [@ytd] )
    )
RETURN
    IF ( ISBLANK ( YtdVariancePercent ), BLANK (), RANKX ( Groups, [@ytd], YtdVariancePercent, DESC, SKIP ) )

Description: Kept as evidence, hidden, not for reports: the plain form of Department Group Rank (YTD Variance %), with the Variance % and YTD calculation written three times (the guard, the table filter and the value) inside RANKX, that docs/performance.md timed and traced before the rewrite. It returns the same ranks as the rewrite (tests/dax/813_naive_equals_rewrite_rank.dax).
Expression:
VAR YtdVariancePercent =
    CALCULATE ( [Comparison Amount], 'Time Intelligence'[Time Calculation] = "YTD", 'Scenario Comparison'[Comparison] = "Variance %" )
RETURN
    IF (
        ISBLANK ( YtdVariancePercent ),
        BLANK (),
        RANKX (
            FILTER (
                ALLSELECTED ( 'Spending Review Group' ),
                NOT ISBLANK (
                    CALCULATE ( [Comparison Amount], 'Time Intelligence'[Time Calculation] = "YTD", 'Scenario Comparison'[Comparison] = "Variance %" )
                )
            ),
            CALCULATE ( [Comparison Amount], 'Time Intelligence'[Time Calculation] = "YTD", 'Scenario Comparison'[Comparison] = "Variance %" ),
            ,
            DESC,
            SKIP
        )
    )

Description: Rank of the department in context among the departments that have a statement amount in the context (1 is the largest amount; equal amounts share a rank and the next rank is skipped), by RANK over the departments of the current structure. Put Department (current structure)[Department] on rows and one statement line and year in the filter context.
Expression:
IF (
    ISBLANK ( [Statement Amount] ),
    BLANK (),
    RANK (
        SKIP,
        FILTER ( ALLSELECTED ( 'Department (current structure)' ), NOT ISBLANK ( [Statement Amount] ) ),
        ORDERBY ( [Statement Amount], DESC )
    )
)

Description: The share of the outturn in context that comes from lines mapped to the current department by an estimated driver: Outturn (estimated mapping) over Outturn (current structure), on net amounts. 0 where the department has outturn and no estimated line; BLANK where it has no outturn or the net outturn is zero. On net amounts it can exceed 100% or be negative where the department's net outturn is small; read it with the amount.
Expression:
VAR Total = [Outturn (current structure)]
RETURN
    IF ( ISBLANK ( Total ), BLANK (), DIVIDE ( COALESCE ( [Outturn (estimated mapping)], 0 ), Total ) )

Description: The size of what the release or releases in context restated, in GBP thousands: the sum of the absolute deltas with a Revision Number above 0, so a restatement upward on one line and downward on another do not net off. The measure for how much was restated, as against how much moved. The rows flagged in Data Quality Issue (the NHS Pension Scheme unit error and its offsetting line) are counted here, trillions in two releases: see the excluding-flagged-rows variant.
Expression: CALCULATE ( SUMX ( 'Fact Outturn', ABS ( 'Fact Outturn'[Amount Delta] ) ), 'Fact Outturn'[Revision Number] > 0 )

Description: Gross Restatement in Release with the rows flagged in Data Quality Issue left out (the thirteen delta rows of the two NHS Pension Scheme lines that carry a unit error, X903A002 and its offsetting line X903A003). What is left out is each flagged line-month as a whole, from the release that set the wrong amount to the release that corrected it, so the genuine amounts netted into the offsetting line in those months go too. Use it for the gross restatement page; the net measures need no exclusion.
Expression: Restate.Unflagged ( [Gross Restatement in Release] )

Description: The size of everything the release or releases in context changed, in GBP thousands: the sum of the absolute deltas, so increases and decreases do not net off. It includes lines reported for the first time, so in the first release of a year it is the size of the whole year to date. It counts the rows flagged in Data Quality Issue (the NHS Pension Scheme unit error and its offsetting line), which run to trillions in two releases: the excluding-flagged-rows variant leaves them out.
Expression: SUMX ( 'Fact Outturn', ABS ( 'Fact Outturn'[Amount Delta] ) )

Description: Gross Revision in Release with the rows flagged in Data Quality Issue left out (the thirteen delta rows of the two NHS Pension Scheme lines that carry a unit error, X903A002 and its offsetting line X903A003). What is left out is each flagged line-month as a whole, from the release that set the wrong amount to the release that corrected it, so the genuine amounts netted into the offsetting line in those months go too. Use it for the gross restatement page; the net measures need no exclusion.
Expression: Restate.Unflagged ( [Gross Revision in Release] )

Description: The month of the latest OSCAR in-year release in the model, for example Sep 2026, whatever is selected. A label for page headers; it holds no amount.
Expression: MAXX ( FILTER ( ALL ( Release ), Release[Is Latest Release] = TRUE () ), Release[Release] )

Description: What the change of structure moved into the department, in GBP thousands: Outturn (current structure) less Outturn (as reported structure). Positive means the department holds more today than it was reported with; negative means lines it was reported with now sit in another department. Added over all departments of the current structure it is zero (tested for every year and release). BLANK where both are BLANK.
Expression:
VAR CurrentStructure = [Outturn (current structure)]
VAR AsReported = [Outturn (as reported structure)]
RETURN
    IF ( ISBLANK ( CurrentStructure ) && ISBLANK ( AsReported ), BLANK (), CurrentStructure - AsReported )

Description: Real outturn in GBP thousands, spending positive and income negative: the sum of the revision deltas of every release in context. With no release selected it is the latest view of each financial year (what the newest release reports). It never filters releases itself, so a view as at a release is a selection on Release. Not on the plan basis: all control budgets and economic categories. Use Outturn (plan basis) to compare with a plan.
Expression: SUM ( 'Fact Outturn'[Amount Delta] )

Description: Outturn in GBP thousands of the lines that the releases in context reported under the department number of the row, whatever department those lines belong to today. The counterpart of a row of Department (current structure) is found by number, never by name: the numbers that a department answers for are in its hidden column Reported Department Numbers (its own number; for Unallocated U011, U035 and U077 the number after the U; and for the Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office also 027, the Foreign and Commonwealth Office). A selection on the as-reported department is kept, so it can only narrow. With Department (current structure) on rows. Added over all departments it equals Outturn.
Expression:
VAR NumberLists = VALUES ( 'Department (current structure)'[Reported Department Numbers] )
VAR Numbers =
    FILTER (
        ALL ( 'Organisation (as reported)'[Department Number (as reported)] ),
        COUNTROWS (
            FILTER (
                NumberLists,
                CONTAINSSTRING (
                    'Department (current structure)'[Reported Department Numbers],
                    "|" & 'Organisation (as reported)'[Department Number (as reported)] & "|"
                )
            )
        ) > 0
    )
RETURN
    CALCULATE (
        [Outturn],
        REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Department (current structure)' ),
        KEEPFILTERS ( TREATAS ( Numbers, 'Organisation (as reported)'[Department Number (as reported)] ) )
    )

Description: Outturn in GBP thousands by the department of today's structure: the sum of the deltas of the lines that belong to the department in context (Fact Outturn is related to Department (current structure) on the department key written in the warehouse, and each department has one number). With Department (current structure) on rows. Equal to Outturn there; it is named so that a matrix holding both structures says which figure is which.
Expression: SUM ( 'Fact Outturn'[Amount Delta] )

Description: [Outturn (current structure)] in 2025-26 prices, in GBP thousands, spending positive and income negative as in the nominal measure. Each financial year in context is multiplied by the GDP deflator index of 2025-26 divided by the index of that year (HM Treasury, default vintage October 2026 Budget, chained index: forecast years are chained from that one vintage), and the years are added. A month takes the index of its financial year. BLANK when a year that has an amount has no index, never the nominal figure. Under Time Intelligence, PY is the previous year in 2025-26 prices, YoY is the real change and YoY % the real growth rate. The Deflator table is related to nothing; the index is matched to the year with TREATAS inside Real.Deflate.
Expression: Real.Deflate ( [Outturn (current structure)] )

Description: The part of the outturn, in GBP thousands, that sits in its current department because of an estimated mapping: the lines marked is_estimated in the current-structure map (three BEIS lines placed by judgement and not by a published source). BLANK where the department has none.
Expression: CALCULATE ( SUM ( 'Fact Outturn'[Amount Delta] ), 'Fact Outturn'[Mapping Is Estimated] = TRUE () )

Description: Outturn in GBP thousands on the basis of the plan rows in context, the figure that Plan is compared with. For each financial year and plan measure in context it takes the outturn of the control budget detail and economic budget the measure is made of (RDEL, RDEL_EX_DEPN, CDEL, RAME, CAME, ADMIN, ADMIN_EX_DEPN, and my own rules for NON_DEPT_AME, NON_BUDGET and UNCLASSIFIED) and adds them up. Resource DEL excluding depreciation leaves out only the economic group DEPRECIATION, because the in-year files have no ringfence column; other non-cash items stay in (about 5.5bn a year from 2024-25). BLANK when there is no plan row in context. Defined at every grain, including months, where Plan is BLANK.
Expression:
VAR MeasureChosen = ISFILTERED ( 'Fact Plan'[Plan Measure] )
VAR PlanScope =
    SUMMARIZE (
        FILTER ( 'Fact Plan', MeasureChosen || NOT 'Fact Plan'[Is Part Of Other Measure] ),
        'Fiscal Year'[Financial Year],
        'Fact Plan'[Plan Measure]
    )
VAR AnyWithoutRule =
    COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( PlanScope, NOT Basis.HasRule ( 'Fact Plan'[Plan Measure] ) ) ) > 0
RETURN
    IF (
        AnyWithoutRule,
        BLANK (),
        SUMX ( PlanScope, Basis.OutturnFor ( 'Fiscal Year'[Financial Year], 'Fact Plan'[Plan Measure] ) )
    )

Description: [Outturn (plan basis)] in 2025-26 prices, in GBP thousands, spending positive and income negative as in the nominal measure. Each financial year in context is multiplied by the GDP deflator index of 2025-26 divided by the index of that year (HM Treasury, default vintage October 2026 Budget, chained index: forecast years are chained from that one vintage), and the years are added. A month takes the index of its financial year. BLANK when a year that has an amount has no index, never the nominal figure. Under Time Intelligence, PY is the previous year in 2025-26 prices, YoY is the real change and YoY % the real growth rate. The Deflator table is related to nothing; the index is matched to the year with TREATAS inside Real.Deflate.
Expression: Real.Deflate ( [Outturn (plan basis)] )

Description: [Outturn] in 2025-26 prices, in GBP thousands, spending positive and income negative as in the nominal measure. Each financial year in context is multiplied by the GDP deflator index of 2025-26 divided by the index of that year (HM Treasury, default vintage October 2026 Budget, chained index: forecast years are chained from that one vintage), and the years are added. A month takes the index of its financial year. BLANK when a year that has an amount has no index, never the nominal figure. Under Time Intelligence, PY is the previous year in 2025-26 prices, YoY is the real change and YoY % the real growth rate. The Deflator table is related to nothing; the index is matched to the year with TREATAS inside Real.Deflate.
Expression: Real.Deflate ( [Outturn] )

Description: The outturn as the selected release stated it, in GBP thousands (spending positive, income negative): the sum of the revision deltas of every release up to and including the highest release in context, or up to the latest release when none is selected. For a year the release has not reached yet it is BLANK, and for a closed year it is the final figure known at that release. At a release's own financial year it equals what that release's file reports (tested against the control totals of the files). Written with a column filter on Release Sequence after REMOVEFILTERS on the Release table; it returns the same figures as the plain form kept hidden as Outturn as at Release (naive), and docs/performance.md says what the rewrite changed and what it did not.
Expression:
VAR AsAt = MAX ( 'Release'[Release Sequence] )
RETURN
    CALCULATE ( [Outturn], REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Release' ), 'Release'[Release Sequence] <= AsAt )

Description: Kept as evidence, hidden, not for reports: the plain form of Outturn as at Release (a CALCULATE over a FILTER of ALL releases up to the highest in context) that docs/performance.md timed and traced before the rewrite. It returns the same figures as the rewrite (tests/dax/810_naive_equals_rewrite_as_at_by_year.dax, 811_naive_equals_rewrite_as_at_by_department.dax and 812_naive_equals_rewrite_as_at_year_department.dax) and is only here so that the comparison can be rerun.
Expression:
VAR AsAt = MAX ( 'Release'[Release Sequence] )
RETURN
    CALCULATE ( [Outturn], FILTER ( ALL ( 'Release' ), 'Release'[Release Sequence] <= AsAt ) )

Description: The outturn as first reported, in GBP thousands: the sum of the deltas with Revision Number 0, that is the amount each line and month had in the release that first reported it, over the releases up to the as-at release (the highest release in context, or the latest). A line first reported later is counted at its first amount, so this is not the total of the first release of the year.
Expression:
VAR AsAt = MAX ( 'Release'[Release Sequence] )
RETURN
    CALCULATE ( [Outturn], 'Fact Outturn'[Revision Number] = 0, FILTER ( ALL ( 'Release' ), 'Release'[Release Sequence] <= AsAt ) )

Description: The part of Revision in Release that changes a figure an earlier release had already reported, in GBP thousands: the deltas with a Revision Number above 0. It is the restatement proper; a delta with Revision Number 0 is a month or line reported for the first time.
Expression: CALCULATE ( SUM ( 'Fact Outturn'[Amount Delta] ), 'Fact Outturn'[Revision Number] > 0 )

Description: Revision since First Reported as a share of the absolute outturn as first reported. BLANK where nothing was first reported or the first-reported amount is zero. Not an additive measure: a total is the ratio of the totals. Needs no data-quality exclusion: the NHS Pension Scheme unit error and its offsetting line net to a small amount, and both are flagged, so a view that left out only one of them would make the ratio worse, not better.
Expression:
VAR FirstReported = [Outturn as First Reported]
RETURN
    DIVIDE ( [Revision since First Reported], ABS ( FirstReported ) )

Description: The change the release or releases in context made to the year-to-date outturn, in GBP thousands: the sum of their deltas, which is what Outturn shows when Release is on rows. It is a movement, not a total, and it mixes months reported for the first time with restatements of months already reported (Restatement in Release is the second part alone). With no release selected it is the sum over all releases, which equals Outturn.
Expression: SUM ( 'Fact Outturn'[Amount Delta] )

Description: How much the outturn has moved since each line and month was first reported, in GBP thousands: Outturn as at Release less Outturn as First Reported, which is the sum of the deltas with a Revision Number above 0 up to the as-at release. Positive means spending grew or income fell since first reported. BLANK where neither side has a value, 0 where nothing was restated.
Expression:
VAR AtRelease = [Outturn as at Release]
VAR FirstReported = [Outturn as First Reported]
RETURN
    IF ( ISBLANK ( AtRelease ) && ISBLANK ( FirstReported ), BLANK (), AtRelease - FirstReported )

Description: The group income and expenditure statement: the outturn of the statement line in context, in GBP thousands, in the sign the line is presented in (income lines positive, the net and total lines as reported, spending positive). A detail line sums the accounts the authored rules give it; a subtotal or total sums the detail lines under the lines it lists; a spacer, and a context with more than one line, give BLANK. The total line equals Outturn. Put Statement Line[Line] on rows; Control Budget on columns splits it into DEL, AME and non-budget.
Expression: Pnl.LineAmount ( [Outturn] )

Description: The statement amount on the plan's basis, only where the line has a plan (the net resource line, the net capital line and the total line, in a year the source gives a plan at that level): for each voted budget the year has, the outturn of the control budget detail and economic budget it is made of, within the line's economic budget. This is the Actual that Variance is taken against; BLANK where Statement Plan is BLANK.
Expression: IF ( ISBLANK ( [Statement Plan] ), BLANK (), Pnl.AtPlanScope ( [Comparison Amount] ) )

Description: [Statement Amount] in 2025-26 prices, in GBP thousands, spending positive and income negative as in the nominal measure. Each financial year in context is multiplied by the GDP deflator index of 2025-26 divided by the index of that year (HM Treasury, default vintage October 2026 Budget, chained index: forecast years are chained from that one vintage), and the years are added. A month takes the index of its financial year. BLANK when a year that has an amount has no index, never the nominal figure. Under Time Intelligence, PY is the previous year in 2025-26 prices, YoY is the real change and YoY % the real growth rate. The Deflator table is related to nothing; the index is matched to the year with TREATAS inside Real.Deflate.
Expression: Real.Deflate ( [Statement Amount] )

Description: The statement amount of the period in context and the two before it, by WINDOW over the allocated months (period 1 to 12) of every year in order, so the window crosses the year end. Period 0 is not a month: it gets BLANK and is not in anyone's window. Use it with Fiscal Period[Financial Year] and Fiscal Period[Period Number] on the visual.
Expression:
CALCULATE (
    [Statement Amount],
    WINDOW (
        -2, REL, 0, REL,
        FILTER ( ALLSELECTED ( 'Fiscal Period'[Period Key], 'Fiscal Period'[Period Number] ), 'Fiscal Period'[Period Number] >= 1 ),
        ORDERBY ( 'Fiscal Period'[Period Key], ASC )
    ),
    REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Fiscal Year' ),
    REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Fiscal Period'[Financial Year], 'Fiscal Period'[Period Number] )
)

Description: The statement amount of the previous financial year, by OFFSET over the Fiscal Year table in order of year start (the year before in the table, whatever a slicer selects). Use it at year grain; BLANK for the first year and for a year the previous year of which has no outturn.
Expression:
CALCULATE (
    [Statement Amount],
    OFFSET ( -1, ALL ( 'Fiscal Year'[Financial Year], 'Fiscal Year'[Year Start] ), ORDERBY ( 'Fiscal Year'[Year Start], ASC ) )
)

Description: The statement amount added up from period 0 to the period in context within each financial year, by WINDOW over Fiscal Period (a running total that restarts every year). Use it with Fiscal Period[Financial Year] and Fiscal Period[Period Number] on the visual.
Expression:
CALCULATE (
    [Statement Amount],
    WINDOW (
        1, ABS, 0, REL,
        ALLSELECTED ( 'Fiscal Period'[Financial Year], 'Fiscal Period'[Period Number] ),
        ORDERBY ( 'Fiscal Period'[Period Number], ASC ),
        PARTITIONBY ( 'Fiscal Period'[Financial Year] )
    )
)

Description: Statement amount on the plan's basis less the plan, GBP thousands, in the sign the line is presented in. With spending positive, below zero is favourable. BLANK where either side is BLANK.
Expression:
VAR Actual = [Statement Amount (plan basis)]
VAR PlanAmount = [Statement Plan]
RETURN
    IF ( ISBLANK ( Actual ) || ISBLANK ( PlanAmount ), BLANK (), Actual - PlanAmount )

Description: Statement variance divided by the absolute statement plan. BLANK where the plan is zero or either side is BLANK.
Expression:
VAR Actual = [Statement Amount (plan basis)]
VAR PlanAmount = [Statement Plan]
RETURN
    IF ( ISBLANK ( Actual ) || ISBLANK ( PlanAmount ), BLANK (), DIVIDE ( Actual - PlanAmount, ABS ( PlanAmount ) ) )

Description: Paybill per full-time equivalent per month, in pounds: Pay Paybill over the full-time equivalent months in context. Over a year it is the average monthly cost of one full-time equivalent.
Expression:
DIVIDE (
    [Pay Paybill],
    SUMX (
        VALUES ( 'Fact Pay Bridge (derived)'[Period Key] ),
        CALCULATE ( SUM ( 'Fact Pay Bridge (derived)'[FTE Current] ) )
    )
)

Description: Current paybill less prior paybill of the bridge, in pounds.
Expression:
IF (
    NOT ISBLANK ( [Pay Bridge Current Paybill] ) || NOT ISBLANK ( [Pay Bridge Prior Paybill] ),
    COALESCE ( [Pay Bridge Current Paybill], 0 ) - COALESCE ( [Pay Bridge Prior Paybill], 0 )
)

Description: Payroll paybill, in pounds, of the organisations in the bridge in the later of the two months (continuing and entry), against Pay Bridge Prior Paybill the same month a year earlier. Not the whole of a department: cells that are not valid are left out (see Pay Bridge Rows Not Bridged).
Expression:
CALCULATE (
    SUM ( 'Fact Pay Bridge (derived)'[Paybill Current] ),
    KEEPFILTERS ( 'Fact Pay Bridge (derived)'[Bridge Class] IN { "continuing", "entry" } )
)

Description: The paybill of organisations valid in the later month and not a year earlier (a body that joined the department, or one that moved in from another), less the paybill of organisations valid a year earlier and not in the later month (a body that left or moved out). A department that has no valid cell in one of the two months is not bridged at all, so a gap in the data is never read as an entry or an exit.
Expression:
VAR BridgedRows =
    CALCULATE (
        COUNTROWS ( 'Fact Pay Bridge (derived)' ),
        KEEPFILTERS ( 'Fact Pay Bridge (derived)'[Bridge Class] IN { "continuing", "entry", "exit" } )
    )
RETURN
    IF (
        BridgedRows > 0,
        COALESCE (
            CALCULATE (
                SUM ( 'Fact Pay Bridge (derived)'[Paybill Current] ),
                KEEPFILTERS ( 'Fact Pay Bridge (derived)'[Bridge Class] = "entry" )
            ),
            0
        )
            - COALESCE (
                CALCULATE (
                    SUM ( 'Fact Pay Bridge (derived)'[Paybill Prior] ),
                    KEEPFILTERS ( 'Fact Pay Bridge (derived)'[Bridge Class] = "exit" )
                ),
                0
            )
    )

Description: The part of the change in paybill that comes from the mix of organisations: the continuing organisations' own volume (their change in full-time equivalent at their own prior average cost) less the volume of the selection as a whole. Zero for a single organisation, and for a department of one organisation. At group level it includes the shift between departments.
Expression:
VAR BridgedRows =
    CALCULATE (
        COUNTROWS ( 'Fact Pay Bridge (derived)' ),
        KEEPFILTERS ( 'Fact Pay Bridge (derived)'[Bridge Class] IN { "continuing", "entry", "exit" } )
    )
RETURN
    IF (
        BridgedRows > 0,
        COALESCE (
            CALCULATE (
                SUM ( 'Fact Pay Bridge (derived)'[Organisation Volume] ),
                KEEPFILTERS ( 'Fact Pay Bridge (derived)'[Bridge Class] = "continuing" )
            ),
            0
        )
            - [Pay Bridge Volume]
    )

Description: Payroll paybill, in pounds, of the organisations in the bridge a year before the month in context (continuing and exit). Prior + volume + rate + mix + entry and exit = current paybill, and Pay Bridge Tie Difference shows that difference, which is zero. Volume and mix are worked out on the selection, month by month, and are not additive over departments; volume plus mix, rate and entry and exit are.
Expression:
CALCULATE (
    SUM ( 'Fact Pay Bridge (derived)'[Paybill Prior] ),
    KEEPFILTERS ( 'Fact Pay Bridge (derived)'[Bridge Class] IN { "continuing", "exit" } )
)

Description: The part of the change in paybill that comes from a change in average cost: the sum over continuing organisations of the current full-time equivalent times the change in the organisation's paybill per full-time equivalent. Additive over any selection.
Expression:
VAR BridgedRows =
    CALCULATE (
        COUNTROWS ( 'Fact Pay Bridge (derived)' ),
        KEEPFILTERS ( 'Fact Pay Bridge (derived)'[Bridge Class] IN { "continuing", "entry", "exit" } )
    )
RETURN
    IF (
        BridgedRows > 0,
        COALESCE (
            CALCULATE (
                SUM ( 'Fact Pay Bridge (derived)'[Organisation Rate] ),
                KEEPFILTERS ( 'Fact Pay Bridge (derived)'[Bridge Class] = "continuing" )
            ),
            0
        )
    )

Description: How many department, organisation and month rows were left out of the bridge, for either of two reasons shown by Not Bridged Reason: the cell of the other month exists and is not valid, or the department has no valid cell in one of the two months. 0 when none.
Expression:
CALCULATE (
    COUNTROWS ( 'Fact Pay Bridge (derived)' ),
    KEEPFILTERS ( 'Fact Pay Bridge (derived)'[Bridge Class] = "not_bridged" )
) + 0

Description: One value of the waterfall: the amount of the bridge step in context (Pay Bridge Step), in pounds. The prior paybill, then the four effects; the waterfall's own total bar is the current paybill.
Expression:
SWITCH (
    SELECTEDVALUE ( 'Pay Bridge Step'[Step Order] ),
    1, [Pay Bridge Prior Paybill],
    2, [Pay Bridge Volume],
    3, [Pay Bridge Rate],
    4, [Pay Bridge Mix],
    5, [Pay Bridge Entry and Exit]
)

Description: The change in paybill less volume, rate, mix and entry and exit, in pounds, rounded to 4 decimal places. It is zero by construction; it is shown so that a reader can see the bridge adds up, and a test checks it.
Expression:
IF (
    NOT ISBLANK ( [Pay Bridge Change] ),
    ROUND (
        [Pay Bridge Change] - ( [Pay Bridge Volume] + [Pay Bridge Rate] + [Pay Bridge Mix] + [Pay Bridge Entry and Exit] ),
        4
    )
)

Description: The part of the change in paybill that comes from a change in the number of full-time equivalent staff of the continuing organisations, valued at their prior average cost (paybill per full-time equivalent). Worked out month by month on the organisations in context, then added over months.
Expression:
VAR BridgedRows =
    CALCULATE (
        COUNTROWS ( 'Fact Pay Bridge (derived)' ),
        KEEPFILTERS ( 'Fact Pay Bridge (derived)'[Bridge Class] IN { "continuing", "entry", "exit" } )
    )
RETURN
    IF (
        BridgedRows > 0,
        COALESCE (
            SUMX (
                VALUES ( 'Fact Pay Bridge (derived)'[Period Key] ),
                VAR FteNow =
                    CALCULATE (
                        SUM ( 'Fact Pay Bridge (derived)'[FTE Current] ),
                        KEEPFILTERS ( 'Fact Pay Bridge (derived)'[Bridge Class] = "continuing" )
                    )
                VAR FtePrior =
                    CALCULATE (
                        SUM ( 'Fact Pay Bridge (derived)'[FTE Prior] ),
                        KEEPFILTERS ( 'Fact Pay Bridge (derived)'[Bridge Class] = "continuing" )
                    )
                VAR PayPrior =
                    CALCULATE (
                        SUM ( 'Fact Pay Bridge (derived)'[Paybill Prior] ),
                        KEEPFILTERS ( 'Fact Pay Bridge (derived)'[Bridge Class] = "continuing" )
                    )
                RETURN
                    IF ( FtePrior <> 0, ( FteNow - FtePrior ) * DIVIDE ( PayPrior, FtePrior ) )
            ),
            0
        )
    )

Description: Payroll full-time equivalent of every valid organisation-month cell in the month in context. Over several months it is the average of the monthly totals, not their sum (a stock, not a flow).
Expression:
AVERAGEX (
    VALUES ( 'Fact Pay Bridge (derived)'[Period Key] ),
    CALCULATE ( SUM ( 'Fact Pay Bridge (derived)'[FTE Current] ) )
)

Description: Payroll paybill in pounds of every valid organisation-month cell in context (the later month of each pair), whether or not it could be compared with a year earlier. The trend measures use this basis. Added over months.
Expression: SUM ( 'Fact Pay Bridge (derived)'[Paybill Current] )

Description: Published plan in GBP thousands, summed over the plan rows in context, BLANK wherever the filter context is finer than the grain the plan is published at (a month, a sub-segment, an economic category, a department, a data quality issue, and an organisation, control budget or economic budget where the source has none). Grain A (OSCAR Plans) is published by organisation, control budget detail and economic budget, so a selection of those on the outturn side narrows the plan to the same codes. Administration budgets are part of resource DEL and are left out unless a Plan measure is chosen. Plan measures overlap by design; choose one to read it on its own.
Expression:
IF (
    Grain.BelowGrain ( FALSE () ),
    BLANK (),
    CALCULATE (
        SUM ( 'Fact Plan'[Plan Amount] ),
        Plan.RowsInScope ( ISFILTERED ( 'Fact Plan'[Plan Measure] ) )
    )
)

Description: [Plan] in 2025-26 prices, in GBP thousands, spending positive and income negative as in the nominal measure. Each financial year in context is multiplied by the GDP deflator index of 2025-26 divided by the index of that year (HM Treasury, default vintage October 2026 Budget, chained index: forecast years are chained from that one vintage), and the years are added. A month takes the index of its financial year. BLANK when a year that has an amount has no index, never the nominal figure. Under Time Intelligence, PY is the previous year in 2025-26 prices, YoY is the real change and YoY % the real growth rate. The Deflator table is related to nothing; the index is matched to the year with TREATAS inside Real.Deflate.
Expression: Real.Deflate ( [Plan] )

Description: Plan on the Plan scenario and outturn on the plan's basis on the Outturn scenario (read with the Scenario filter removed, because the plan rows that define the basis sit on the Plan scenario), in one measure, so that a waterfall can take Scenario as its category and a department group as its breakdown. BLANK for every other scenario and when more than one scenario is in context. Plan keeps its grain guard, so it is BLANK where it is not published.
Expression:
SWITCH (
    SELECTEDVALUE ( Scenario[Scenario] ),
    "Plan", [Plan],
    "Outturn", CALCULATE ( [Outturn (plan basis)], REMOVEFILTERS ( Scenario ) ),
    BLANK ()
)

Description: 1 where Plan is BLANK because the filter context is finer than the grain the plan is published at, otherwise 0. Use it to say "plan not published at this level" next to a blank.
Expression: IF ( Grain.BelowGrain ( FALSE () ), 1, 0 )

Description: The plan badge: the plan source and edition, and the grain it is published at, of the plan rows in the filter context (the year in view), for example a Supplementary Estimate at financial year x department group x measure. Several sources are joined with a semicolon. When the selection is finer than the plan's grain the text says the plan is blank, in the words the Plan measure follows. It is a label and holds no amount.
Expression:
VAR Sources =
    CALCULATETABLE (
        SUMMARIZE ( 'Fact Plan', 'Plan Source'[Plan Source], 'Plan Grain'[Plan Grain] ),
        Plan.RowsInScope ( ISFILTERED ( 'Fact Plan'[Plan Measure] ) )
    )
VAR Names =
    CONCATENATEX ( Sources, 'Plan Source'[Plan Source] & " at " & 'Plan Grain'[Plan Grain], "; ", 'Plan Source'[Plan Source], ASC )
RETURN
    IF (
        COUNTROWS ( Sources ) = 0,
        "No plan is published for this selection",
        Names & IF ( Grain.BelowGrain ( FALSE () ), ". The selection is finer than the plan's grain, so the plan is blank.", "" )
    )

Description: The published plan of the statement line in context, in GBP thousands, only on a line that sits at a plan's grain: the net resource line (economic budget RESOURCE), the net capital line (CAPITAL) and the total line (every account), and only in a year where the source publishes a plan at that level (the OSCAR Plans years for RESOURCE and CAPITAL; every year with a plan for the total). The voted budgets only: RDEL, RDEL_EX_DEPN, CDEL, RAME, CAME. BLANK on every other line.
Expression: Pnl.AtPlanScope ( [Plan] )

Description: [Statement Plan] in 2025-26 prices, in GBP thousands, spending positive and income negative as in the nominal measure. Each financial year in context is multiplied by the GDP deflator index of 2025-26 divided by the index of that year (HM Treasury, default vintage October 2026 Budget, chained index: forecast years are chained from that one vintage), and the years are added. A month takes the index of its financial year. BLANK when a year that has an amount has no index, never the nominal figure. Under Time Intelligence, PY is the previous year in 2025-26 prices, YoY is the real change and YoY % the real growth rate. The Deflator table is related to nothing; the index is matched to the year with TREATAS inside Real.Deflate.
Expression: Real.Deflate ( [Statement Plan] )

Description: DERIVED, not published: the plan rows that Plan adds up, spread over periods 1 to 12 by a share taken from the prior year's outturn (twelve flat twelfths where there is none), in GBP thousands. The only plan measure allowed at month grain. The twelve months of a plan row add up to the published annual figure exactly, but the monthly figures are my allocation and must never be shown as a published monthly budget. BLANK below the group grain (sub-segment, economic category and so on) like Plan, and for FY2017-18, which has no calendar.
Expression:
IF (
    Grain.BelowGrain ( TRUE () ),
    BLANK (),
    VAR PlanKeys =
        SELECTCOLUMNS (
            Plan.RowsInScope (
                ISFILTERED ( 'Fact Plan'[Plan Measure] ) || ISFILTERED ( 'Fact Plan Phased (derived)'[Plan Measure] )
            ),
            "k", 'Fact Plan'[Plan Fact Key]
        )
    RETURN
        CALCULATE (
            SUM ( 'Fact Plan Phased (derived)'[Phased Amount] ),
            TREATAS ( PlanKeys, 'Fact Plan Phased (derived)'[Plan Fact Key] )
        )
)

Description: DERIVED, not published: the phased plan is my allocation of the published annual plan. [Plan (phased)] in 2025-26 prices, in GBP thousands, spending positive and income negative as in the nominal measure. Each financial year in context is multiplied by the GDP deflator index of 2025-26 divided by the index of that year (HM Treasury, default vintage October 2026 Budget, chained index: forecast years are chained from that one vintage), and the years are added. A month takes the index of its financial year. BLANK when a year that has an amount has no index, never the nominal figure. Under Time Intelligence, PY is the previous year in 2025-26 prices, YoY is the real change and YoY % the real growth rate. The Deflator table is related to nothing; the index is matched to the year with TREATAS inside Real.Deflate.
Expression: Real.Deflate ( [Plan (phased)] )

Description: DERIVED, not published: outturn on the plan's basis less the phased plan, GBP thousands, in the period context (a month, or the year to date under Time Intelligence). The plan side is my allocation of a published annual plan, so the figure is a variance to my profile and not to a published monthly budget. Below zero is favourable with spending positive. BLANK where either side is BLANK, including below the group grain.
Expression:
VAR Actual = [Outturn (plan basis)]
VAR PhasedPlan = [Plan (phased)]
RETURN
    IF ( ISBLANK ( Actual ) || ISBLANK ( PhasedPlan ), BLANK (), Actual - PhasedPlan )

Description: DERIVED, not published: the variance to the phased plan as a share of the absolute phased plan. BLANK where the phased plan is zero or either side is BLANK.
Expression:
VAR Actual = [Outturn (plan basis)]
VAR PhasedPlan = [Plan (phased)]
RETURN
    IF ( ISBLANK ( Actual ) || ISBLANK ( PhasedPlan ), BLANK (), DIVIDE ( Actual - PhasedPlan, ABS ( PhasedPlan ) ) )

Description: Income statement and cash flow amount of the year in GBP thousands, TAC sign (income and inflows positive, expenses and outflows negative): the current-year column, added over providers, lines of kind line and, being a flow, over years. A subtotal or total is never added to its own components; on a single line the measure shows that line as published. BLANK for the balance sheet, which has TAC Closing Balance.
Expression:
CALCULATE (
    SUM ( 'Fact TAC'[Value] ),
    'Fact TAC'[Period Column] = "CY",
    KEEPFILTERS ( 'TAC Statement Line'[Statement Code] <> "SoFP" ),
    Tac.LineKinds ()
)

Description: The published cash flow, GBP thousands, TAC sign (an inflow is positive): the current-year column of the lines of the cash flow statement that are compared with a line of the derived cash flow (all published lines of the three activity sections; never a subtotal). Select a line of TAC Cash Flow Line to see the published lines it is compared with.
Expression:
CALCULATE (
    SUM ( 'Fact TAC'[Value] ),
    'Fact TAC'[Period Column] = "CY",
    KEEPFILTERS ( 'TAC Statement Line'[Statement Code] = "SoCF" ),
    'TAC Statement Line'[Line Kind] = "line",
    'TAC Statement Line'[Cash Flow Line Key] <> 0
)

Description: The movement of cash and cash equivalents on the balance sheet, GBP thousands, TAC sign: the closing balance of the last year in context less the opening balance of the first (BAL1240). Over one year it is the cash movement of the year; over several years it is the movement across them, with the restated opening of the first year.
Expression:
CALCULATE ( [TAC Closing Balance], 'TAC Statement Line'[Sub Code] = "BAL1240" )
    - CALCULATE ( [TAC Opening Balance], 'TAC Statement Line'[Sub Code] = "BAL1240" )

Description: Balance sheet closing balance in GBP thousands, TAC sign (assets positive, liabilities negative): the current-year column of the balance sheet in the last financial year that is in the filter context and has statements. It is semi-additive over time: over several years it shows the last year and never the sum, and a provider with no statements in that year (dissolved, merged or acquired earlier) contributes nothing. Added over providers and over lines of kind line; on a single line it shows that line as published, a subtotal included. BLANK for the income statement and cash flow.
Expression:
VAR LastYear = Tac.LastYear ()
RETURN
    IF (
        NOT ISBLANK ( LastYear ),
        CALCULATE (
            SUM ( 'Fact TAC'[Value] ),
            'Fact TAC'[Period Column] = "CY",
            'Fact TAC'[Release Start] = LastYear,
            KEEPFILTERS ( 'TAC Statement Line'[Statement Code] = "SoFP" ),
            Tac.LineKinds ()
        )
    )

Description: The increase or decrease in cash and cash equivalents the providers publish in their cash flow statements, GBP thousands, TAC sign (SCF0320, read as published on its own line and added over providers and years). It adds the three published section subtotals.
Expression: CALCULATE ( [TAC Amount], 'TAC Statement Line'[Sub Code] = "SCF0320" )

Description: Balance sheet opening balance in GBP thousands, TAC sign: the prior-year column of the same file, as the provider restated it, in the first financial year that is in the filter context. Semi-additive like the closing balance: over several years it shows the opening of the first year. Added over providers and lines of kind line; on a single line it shows that line as published.
Expression:
VAR FirstYear = Tac.FirstYear ()
RETURN
    IF (
        NOT ISBLANK ( FirstYear ),
        CALCULATE (
            SUM ( 'Fact TAC'[Value] ),
            'Fact TAC'[Period Column] = "PY",
            'Fact TAC'[Release Start] = FirstYear,
            KEEPFILTERS ( 'TAC Statement Line'[Statement Code] = "SoFP" ),
            Tac.LineKinds ()
        )
    )

Measure: TAC Opening less Prior Year Closing
Description: TAC Opening Balance less TAC Prior Year Closing Balance, GBP thousands: how far the opening balance a provider publishes differs from the closing balance it published a year earlier. It includes the providers that appear or disappear between the two files (a merger, an acquisition, a provider excluded from one file), so it is wider than TAC Restatement, which compares only the values both files hold.
Expression:
VAR Opening = [TAC Opening Balance]
VAR Prior = [TAC Prior Year Closing Balance]
RETURN
    IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( Opening ) || NOT ISBLANK ( Prior ), Opening - Prior )

Description: The closing balance of the year before the first financial year in context, in GBP thousands, TAC sign: the current-year column of the previous year's file, as that file published it. Compare with TAC Opening Balance, which is the same date as restated in the next file. BLANK where there is no earlier file (2019-20).
Expression:
VAR FirstYear = Tac.FirstYear ()
RETURN
    IF (
        NOT ISBLANK ( FirstYear ),
        CALCULATE (
            SUM ( 'Fact TAC'[Value] ),
            REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Fiscal Year' ),
            'Fact TAC'[Period Column] = "CY",
            'Fact TAC'[Release Start] = FirstYear - 1,
            KEEPFILTERS ( 'TAC Statement Line'[Statement Code] = "SoFP" ),
            Tac.LineKinds ()
        )
    )

Description: The sum of the provider accounts for one line of the elimination-gap control in one financial year, GBP thousands, TAC sign: the current-year column of the control line's statement lines, added over providers. BLANK unless one control line and one year are in context.
Expression:
IF (
    HASONEVALUE ( 'TAC Control Line'[Control Line Key] ) && HASONEVALUE ( 'Fiscal Year'[Financial Year] ),
    CALCULATE (
        SUM ( 'Fact TAC'[Value] ),
        'Fact TAC'[Period Column] = "CY",
        TREATAS ( VALUES ( 'TAC Control Member'[Line Key] ), 'TAC Statement Line'[Line Key] )
    )
)

Description: Number of providers with statements in the last financial year in context. A provider that no longer exists is not counted in a year after its last statements.
Expression:
VAR LastYear = Tac.LastYear ()
RETURN
    IF (
        NOT ISBLANK ( LastYear ),
        CALCULATE (
            DISTINCTCOUNT ( 'Fact TAC'[Provider Key] ),
            'Fact TAC'[Period Column] = "CY",
            'Fact TAC'[Release Start] = LastYear
        )
    )

Description: The restatement of the year's opening figures, GBP thousands, TAC sign: for every provider and line that has a prior-year value in this year's file and a current-year value in last year's file, the prior-year value less the current-year value, where the two differ by GBP 1,000 or more (the rule of audit.tac_prior_year_difference). Reasons are restatements, reclassifications and mergers; I have not explained them one by one. Added over lines of kind line and over years; a single line shows its own difference.
Expression:
CALCULATE (
    SUM ( 'Fact TAC'[Restatement Amount] ),
    'Fact TAC'[Period Column] = "PY",
    Tac.LineKinds ()
)

Description: DERIVED: the indirect cash flow in GBP thousands, TAC sign (an inflow is positive), added over providers and years. Each balance-sheet input is the movement of the year (current-year column less prior-year column of the same file), so a restated opening balance does not leak in. Over all its lines it equals the balance sheet cash movement of the year to within GBP 2,000 per provider (the balance sheets balance to less than GBP 1,000). It is a calculation of mine, not a published figure.
Expression: SUM ( 'Fact TAC Cash Flow (derived)'[Cash Flow Amount] )

Description: DERIVED: the derived cash flow less the published cash flow, GBP thousands, for the line, section or total in context. It is what the income statement and balance sheet cannot be made to say about the published cash flow: depreciation and other non-cash items, transfers by absorption, mergers and restated openings. Not forced to zero. On a derived-only line it is the derived amount; on a published-only line it is minus the published amount.
Expression:
VAR Derived = [TAC Cash Flow (derived)]
VAR Published = [TAC Cash Flow (published)]
RETURN
    IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( Derived ) || NOT ISBLANK ( Published ), Derived - Published )

Description: Outturn as at Release (own year) less the file's total, GBP thousands. 0 when the model reproduces the release file; the test that proves it for all 31 releases is tests/dax/780.
Expression:
VAR AsAt = [Outturn as at Release (own year)]
VAR FileTotal = [File Total (4 decimals)]
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( AsAt ) || ISBLANK ( FileTotal ), BLANK (), AsAt - FileTotal )

Description: The total the release file reports, rounded to four decimals as the warehouse stores it, in GBP thousands. Rounding the exact source sum moves a file total by up to about 5.44 (GBP thousands), which is why the exact sum is shown beside it.
Expression: SUM ( 'File Control'[File Total Value] )

Description: Outturn as at Release for the financial year of the release of the file in context: what the model says that release reported, to set beside the file's own total. Needs one file (one release) in context; it reads the release from the file's own row, so it works in a table that shows File Control alone.
Expression:
VAR ReleaseKey = MAX ( 'File Control'[Release Key] )
VAR OwnYear = LOOKUPVALUE ( Release[Release Financial Year], Release[Release Key], ReleaseKey )
RETURN
    IF (
        ISBLANK ( ReleaseKey ),
        BLANK (),
        CALCULATE ( [Outturn as at Release], Release[Release Key] = ReleaseKey, 'Fiscal Year'[Financial Year] = OwnYear )
    )

Description: Rows loaded into the warehouse from the files in context; with the rows quarantined they add up to the rows read.
Expression: SUM ( 'Load Control'[Rows Loaded Value] )

Description: Rows rejected into quarantine from the files in context, each kept with its reason; 0 for every file in the data.
Expression: SUM ( 'Load Control'[Rows Quarantined Value] ) + 0

Description: Data rows read from the files in context: the rows of the source file after its header, before any row is rejected.
Expression: SUM ( 'Load Control'[Rows Read Value] )

Description: Rows of the deflator workbooks and the CPI series that did not parse: the rows of Deflator Quarantine and CPI Quarantine. 0 when every row parses.
Expression: COUNTROWS ( 'Deflator Quarantine' ) + COUNTROWS ( 'CPI Quarantine' ) + 0

Description: Months of a series in context that have at least one published row.
Expression: COUNTROWS ( 'Pay Coverage' )

Description: Full-time equivalent placed on an organisation as a share of the full-time equivalent published, over the series and months in context.
Expression: DIVIDE ( SUM ( 'Pay Coverage'[FTE Mapped] ), SUM ( 'Pay Coverage'[FTE Published] ) )

Description: Paybill placed on an organisation as a share of the paybill published, over the series and months in context.
Expression: DIVIDE ( SUM ( 'Pay Coverage'[Paybill Mapped] ), SUM ( 'Pay Coverage'[Paybill Published] ) )

Description: Published payroll paybill in pounds that the map placed on an organisation, over the series and months in context.
Expression: SUM ( 'Pay Coverage'[Paybill Mapped] )

Description: Published payroll paybill in pounds, over the series and months in context.
Expression: SUM ( 'Pay Coverage'[Paybill Published] )

Description: Total of the plan rows in context, GBP thousands. Plan measures overlap by design (administration budgets are part of resource DEL), so a total across measures is not a plan figure; read it by measure.
Expression: SUM ( 'Plan Coverage'[Amount Total Value] )

Description: AUTHORED: the consolidated figure for the control line and year in context, GBP thousands, TAC sign, as printed in the consolidated NHS provider accounts (GBP million times 1,000). BLANK unless one control line and one year are in context, and BLANK where the user cannot see the provider accounts, so the control is hidden with them.
Expression: IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [TAC Provider Sum (control)] ), SUM ( 'TAC Consolidated Accounts'[Amount] ) )

Description: The sum of the provider accounts less the consolidated figure, GBP thousands, TAC sign: what the consolidation takes out (intra-NHS income, expense and balances between providers) plus whatever else differs between the two populations, which this measure does not separate. A provider whose accounts the TAC file leaves out is in the consolidated accounts and not in the sum. BLANK where either side is.
Expression:
VAR Provider = [TAC Provider Sum (control)]
VAR Consolidated = [TAC Consolidated Total]
RETURN
    IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( Provider ) && NOT ISBLANK ( Consolidated ), Provider - Consolidated )

Description: The elimination gap as a share of the consolidated figure. Positive means the provider sum is larger in size than the consolidated figure, whatever the sign of the line.
Expression: DIVIDE ( [TAC Elimination Gap], [TAC Consolidated Total] )
